newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-JUNINHO GETS COOL WELCOME IN MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUNINHO GETS COOL WELCOME IN MADRID.

text.p: Brazilian midfielder Juninho arrived in Madrid on Wednesday to be greeted by a host of journalists but few fans.
The diminutive 24-year-old -- full name Osvaldo Giraldo Junior -- was clearly surprised at the absence of a frenzied welcome.
Atletico Madrid's $20.2 million signing from English club Middlesbrough was met by eight television crews, a similar number of photographers and more than 20 reporters.
But apart from six giggling schoolgirls there were no supporters of the former Spanish league and cup winners.
For a moment it clearly made Juninho wonder whether he had made the right choice in coming to Spain.
"What I will miss most about Middlesbrough is their supporters. They were right behind me all the time I was at the club," the player said.
But he was soon looking to the future rather than the past.
"I'm really glad to be coming to Atletico because it is one of the great clubs in Spanish soccer and they currently have a good squad," he said.
"I've got a lot of ambitions while I am here. I want to win the Spanish league and the Spanish cup. Next season we are in the UEFA Cup and I hope we can win that as well."
Playing in European club competitions was one of the main attractions of signing for Atletico.
During his two seasons at Middlesbrough, Juninho did not play in Europe. Tottenham, with who he was also linked, failed to qualify for the coming season.
Juninho hopes that the television exposure he will get in Brazil, where Atletico matches are regularly shown, will help him to regain his place in the national squad as the 1998 World Cup approaches.
Despite speculation for nearly two months that Juninho would sign for Atletico, the move was completed only on Tuesday.
"I'm glad all the negotiations are now finished. I always wanted to play in Spain and now I can think about football," Juninho said.
"It's a big responsibility coming here, with everything that has been written about my move and the amount of money."
